name: Mental Traumas
description: Rolled when a Trauma Test fails (each time Insanity Points pass another multiple of 10): roll 1d100 and add +10 for every Degree of Failure. Only War, Table 9-8 (p. 307); Dark Heresy 2e, Table 8-13 (p. 288). The Only War printing skips 121–130; that row is taken from Dark Heresy 2e.

results.name: Withdrawn
results.text: The character becomes withdrawn and quiet. The character is at a –10 to all Fellowship-based Tests for [[3d10]] hours.

results.name: Compulsive
results.text: The character must compulsively perform an action (such as fevered praying, frantically cleaning a weapon, etc.) and pays little attention to anything else. All Tests that are based on Intelligence, Fellowship, or Perception suffer a –10 penalty. This effect lasts for [[3d10]] hours.

results.name: Jumpy
results.text: The character is constantly fearful, seeing danger everywhere, and is extremely jumpy. The character gains a +10 bonus to all Perception-based Tests and is at a –10 penalty to his Willpower for the next [[1d5]] days.

results.name: Temporary phobia
results.text: The character suffers from a temporary Severe phobia (see Disorders, page 306). This effect lasts for [[1d5]] days.

results.name: Agitated
results.text: The character reacts to the slightest stress or pressure by becoming extremely agitated. When performing any task that involves a test, the character must first pass a Willpower test or suffer a –10 modifier to the test. During combat encounters, he suffers a –10 penalty on all tests. This effect lasts for [[1d5]] days. (Dark Heresy 2e, Table 8-13.)

results.name: Nightmares
results.text: The character suffers vivid and extreme nightmares whenever they try to sleep. The next day, and for a further [[1d10]] days, the character will be exhausted by a lack of sleep and gains a level of Fatigue.

results.name: Struck dumb
results.text: The character is struck dumb and is unable to speak. This lasts for [[1d5]] days.

results.name: Distressed
results.text: Extremely distressed and unfocused, the character refuses to eat or drink, and looks to be in a terrible state. The character takes a –10 penalty to all Characteristics (though no Characteristic will be reduced below 1 by this effect) for [[1d10]] days.

results.name: Hysterical blindness
results.text: The character temporarily becomes hysterically blind or deaf. This effect lasts for [[1d10]] days.

results.name: Traumatised
results.text: The character becomes completely traumatised and virtually unresponsive. He can’t initiate actions, but may be gently led. This effect lasts for [[1d10]] days.
